summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that the State of Mali granted the Menankoto exploitation permit to its subsidiary, covering the Fekola Regional project. The permit follows dialogue with Mali since late July 2025 and the September 2024 agreement. Fekola Regional will be owned 65% by B2Gold and 35% by Mali, with pre-stripping to commence and production expected to exceed 150,000 ounces per year from 2028 through the mid-2030s. This is a routine operational/regulatory milestone, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms or strategic review involved.
